lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode in the year 2040: kids at a car-trade museum find that the wax figure of an old car flipper is alive. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Lines: 1 hoarse whisper of a 'statue' coming alive, curious; 2 tired, nostalgic, a bit sad.

guide.profile: Irina Sergeevna — a polite, slightly strict Russian museum guide in her 40s, clear 'excursion' intonation.
guide.notes: Lines: 1 welcoming; 2 explaining like history; 3 proud of the exhibit; 4 alarmed, strict shout.

timur.profile: Timur — a lively, smart Russian schoolboy about 11 years old, cheerful, surprised by old ways.
timur.notes: Lines: 1 genuinely puzzled; 2 friendly, proud, showing a phone.

petya.profile: Petya — an excited Russian schoolboy about 10 years old, bright voice.
petya.notes: Lines: 1 amazed; 2 scared and excited shout.
